cultivation_relevance: High-value commercial horticultural crop cultivated nationwide across multiple seasons for fresh market and processing.

climate_and_soil.climate_type: Warm season vegetable, highly sensitive to frost
climate_and_soil.temperature_range_celsius: Optimal 20°C to 28°C; fruit setting fails when day temp >35°C or night temp <13°C
climate_and_soil.annual_rainfall_mm: Prefers moderate rainfall; heavy rains during harvest cause fruit cracking and disease
soil_types: Deep fertile sandy loam to clay loam rich in organic matter
climate_and_soil.drainage: Must be well-drained on raised beds; standing water leads to damping-off and bacterial wilt within 24 hours

planting_details.sowing_time: Nursery sowing: Kharif (June), Rabi (Sept-Oct), Summer (Dec-Jan). Transplant 25-30 day old seedlings
planting_details.seed_rate: Hybrid seed: 50 to 60 g/acre; Open-pollinated: 150 to 200 g/acre
planting_details.spacing: 90 cm x 60 cm (for indeterminate staked hybrids) or 75 cm x 45 cm (for determinate varieties)
planting_details.sowing_depth: Transplant seedlings at collar level in afternoon on raised beds

water_management.water_requirement_mm: 500 - 600 mm throughout cycle; avoid fluctuating wet-dry cycles which cause blossom end rot and fruit splitting

nutrient_management.fym_manure_per_acre: 8 to 10 tonnes well-decomposed FYM per acre applied 3 weeks prior to bed preparation
nutrient_management.recommended_npk_ratio: 60:40:40 kg/acre N:P2O5:K2O for hybrid tomato (split N into 3 doses; ensure adequate Potassium for fruit firmness)
micronutrients: Calcium Nitrate foliar spray @ 5 g/L to prevent blossom end rot
Borax @ 1 g/L at flowering to prevent flower drop

harvest_and_yield.maturity_days: First harvest at 65-75 DAT; fruiting continues for 60-90 days in indeterminate types
harvest_and_yield.harvesting_signs: Pick at 'breaker' or 'pink' stage for distant transportation; full red-ripe for local consumption
harvest_and_yield.expected_yield_per_acre: 20 to 35 tonnes per acre (800 to 1400 crates) for staked high-yielding hybrids
harvest_and_yield.post_harvest_storage: Sort damaged fruits immediately; store at 12-15°C with 85-90% RH; do not refrigerate below 10°C (chilling injury)
